summary: Complete initial source-scope chronology audit of all 121 Chinese units, all 46 temporal or active-hint items, and all 12 people. This institutional ritual-and-vehicle treatise supplies dated examples involving rulers, officials, ritual enactments, and dynastic inheritance; its extracted chronology is retained as evidence-grounded research holds pending independent source-critical confirmation of person ownership, conversion, endpoint precision, and the distinction between individual activity and institutional context. No source, extraction, or canonical person data was changed.
